messages:
jordan: Heads-up — PR #15802 is blocked by a flaky smoke test on dedicated pool. Buildkite: https://buildkite.com/redwood/pr-15802/builds/4321  

jordan: Test: integration/smoke/user-session times out intermittently on shard 3. Failing assertion shown below. Need advice: targeted rerun or snapshot update? :eyes:

ci-bot: buildkite/pr-15802 #4321 failed — "integration/smoke/user-session" on shard 3 (timeout). Logs: https://logs.buildkite.com/redwood/4321

maya: can you paste the failing assertion and the command you used to reproduce? also which pool (dedicated-rtx-8)?

jordan: sure — pool is dedicated-rtx-8. failing snippet:

```
expect(session.state).toEqual('active');
// got 'initializing' after 30s wait
```

jordan: reproduce locally with CI env: ARTIFACT_MODE=ci ./scripts/test.sh --filter integration/smoke/user-session --shard 3

oliver: looks like a race where the session startup can be slower on the dedicated nodes. two options: bump the test wait timeout + add flaky marker, or rerun the shard and if it passes open snapshot update PR. I can queue a targeted rerun if we want to verify first.

maya: i'd prefer rerun first. if rerun consistently passes we can update snapshots; if it flakes again we should increase the wait.

oliver: queued a targeted rerun (shard 3) — Buildkite rerun: https://buildkite.com/redwood/pr-15802/builds/4322 (targeted rerun by @oliver)

ravi: queued — estimated start in ~2m, i'll watch it. :coffee:

ci-bot: buildkite/pr-15802 #4322 passed — all smoke tests green on targeted rerun (shard 3).

jordan: great, rerun passed. i'll prepare a small PR to update the snapshot and add a short note about the race; want to avoid leaving this brittle. who can approve snapshot changes for infra/rt-specific flakes?

maya: i can review snapshot updates but prefer we add a tiny increase to the timeout (e.g., from 30s -> 45s) so it doesn't regress again.

sophia: @jordan go ahead with the snapshot PR and include the timeout tweak — :thumbsup: from me once it's small and scoped.

oliver: i'll do a quick review on the snapshot PR when it's up, can merge after one more approval.

jordan: plan: open PR with updated snapshot + timeout bump + comment about dedicated-rtx-8 slowness. pinging @sophia and @oliver for reviews, will merge after one approver. thanks all. :pray:

maya: quick follow-up — can you add a short test comment linking the rerun logs and note the shard number? helps later triage.

jordan: will do. thanks!

oliver: nice teamwork. marking this resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
